immutable.title: Read-only immutable version
immutable.description: This page displays an immutable Snapshot. Browsing never changes file content, the Manifest, or version metadata.

candidate.title: Continuously editable working copy
candidate.filesSummary: {{count}} files · Saving writes changed files only
candidate.description: Normal saves only write changed files. Freeze an immutable version when you need a test target, checkpoint, or comparison.

draft.synced: Synced with the current working copy
draft.conflict: The server Draft has changed. Your local text is preserved; compare it with the latest server content before reapplying.
draft.saveNotice: Saving writes changed files only. Save as a version to freeze the complete directory.
draft.versionBasis: the formal version used when this Draft was created
draft.basisNotice: Comparison basis: {{basis}}. No formal version is created in this stage.
draft.noChanges: The Draft matches its fixed comparison basis
draft.confirmDelete: Confirm deletion of {{path}} from the Draft
draft.customIgnore: Custom UI ignore rules (one per line; ! negates)
draft.confirmAbandon: I understand abandoning this Draft creates no formal version and makes the Draft no longer editable.

tree.keyboardHelp: Use arrow keys to browse and Space to open a file

states.noFileSelected: Select a file from the tree
states.unavailableTitle: Inline preview is not available for this file
states.unavailableDescription: You can verify its hash, size, and MIME hint, or download the original through the controlled endpoint.
states.missingFileTitle: The selected file is not present in the Manifest
states.corruptedFileTitle: The file is missing or no longer matches the Manifest
states.snapshotUnavailableTitle: This Snapshot is not currently available for browsing
states.invalidUtf8Title: The file is not valid UTF-8 text
states.binaryFileTitle: Binary files are not rendered inline
states.imageUnavailableTitle: The image is missing, corrupted, or not allowed inline
states.workspaceUnavailable: The workbench does not exist or is temporarily unavailable.

context.changedFilesDescription: All file-level changes against the fixed basis appear here. Select an existing file to open it.
context.versionInfoDescription: Read-only source, Snapshot, and Manifest technical information.

upload.singleDescription: Add a file or replace a file at the same Draft path.
upload.folderDescription: Merge the folder into the current Skill root. Same-path files are replaced and all other files remain.
upload.singleDialogDescription: Choose the destination path inside the Draft. An existing file at that path will be replaced.
upload.folderDialogTitle: Upload a folder to the current Skill
upload.folderDialogDescription: The folder is merged into the current Skill root. Existing files not included in the upload are never deleted.
upload.replaceWarning: An existing path is replaced in the working copy. This does not automatically save a version.
upload.previewRequired: Preview additions and same-path replacements first. After confirmation, the folder is merged into the current Draft.

fileActions.moveDescription: Change the current file's relative path inside the Draft.
fileActions.deleteWarning: Deletion changes only the working copy. Existing immutable versions are not affected.

lifecycle.publishTodoDescription: Publication becomes available after the test release gate is connected.
lifecycle.abandonDescription: This is a Draft-level action and does not apply only to the selected file.
